component.name: OmaTree (egui)
component.summary: A local-first notebook for people who think in trees

description.p: OmaTree is a deliberately simple note-taking application: a tree of notes on the left and the selected note on the right. Every note can have child notes, so ideas branch the way your thinking does.
Notes are Markdown that you edit in place. A notebook is a single local .omatree file on your computer. There is no account and no cloud service.

This is the egui version of OmaTree, installable next to the Qt version while the two coexist. A notebook stays in its old format until it needs a newer one: saving a pasted image makes it schema version 4 and saving a colour tag makes it version 5. OmaTree 0.1.2 and earlier refuse to open versions 4 and 5, so keep a copy of notebooks you still need there.
First Rust and egui prerelease, for Linux x86_64. It installs next to the Qt version and uses a notebook format (schema 4 and 5, only when needed) that OmaTree 0.1.2 cannot open.
Pre-release packaging of the egui version, for testing next to the Qt version.
